data.name: No Witnesses
data.detailed_description:
At least one person in this lobby is a Killer... Nobody saw it happen... It's your job to work it out and make sure they meet their maker. A comedic multiplayer where reading the room matters just as much as aiming and where a perfectly tense standoff can be ruined (improved?) by everyone suddenly shrinking to the size of a soda can...

  • Play online or with your friends, up to 16 players (4 / 8 / 12 / 16 supported)

  • 16 maps out of the box

    • Steam Workshop support to make your own or use the community made maps!

  • Play with your friends, or total strangers - friends-only lobbies, a full server browser and dedicated server support

  • 51 Steam Achievements!

  • 12 Languages

Bystander

Survive, and don't get blamed. Anyone can identify a corpse - but can you provde who did it before someone points the finger at you? Scour the environment for random gifts, cash money or just weapons to defend yourself with. And remember, at every turn, those who you trust the most, might just turn out to betray you. 

Detective (4+ Players)

In bigger lobbies you will be the ultimate assistant, use your specialised skillset to aid the Bystanders and clutch the victory. Purchase effective tools from the shop to aid you in your mission, but be careful, everyone knows your role. Killers will be out to slaughter you at the first opportunity and Bystanders will trust your every word, so be careful who you blame.

Killer

Act natural and don't raise suspicion. Remember, witnesses can talk and bodies leave evidence. Your goal is to eliminate every non-Killer player in the lobby to earn the ultimate bragging rights within your circle, but don't get too cocky, you might just fall into a trap. Purchase specalised weaponry and equipment from the shop but there's a catch. Don't let anyone see you with them, or you'll be scrambling for an excuse - or the trigger. The choice is yours.

Your Decisions Matter

Whether you play as a Bystander, a Detective or a Killer, your decisions affect your reputation with your friends. Over time they'll learn who can be trusted and who is a trigger-happy know-it-all. Make the wrong choices and your reputation will dwindle, let it fall too far and you'll meet your demise, potentially ending your winning-streak!

Pure Chaos, Every Round

This is a comedy first and a whodunnit second. Mystery gifts, phone-box killer contracts and pure chaos events sling 22 different effects across the lobby at the worst possible moments, including:

  • Moon gravity firefights and "Honey, I shrunk the kids" brawls

  • Giant heads, clown hats, bouncy legs and banana-slick floors

  • Disco guns that make you dance, confetti guns that do nothing, reverse cards that fling your bad luck onto someone else

  • "The floor is lava" - a childhood classic brought to life, jump or feel the heat of the ground

Answer the phone. Or don't.

A mysterious phonebox starts ringing. If you're the Killer, it's a timed contract with a reward for a specific mark. If you're not the Killer and you pick it up anyway you get one warning to not be so nosey... Just remember the phrase "Curiosity killed the cat"...

Gear Up

Find stacks of cash around the map and spend it at the in-round shop: deploy a decoy, disguise yourself as another player, revive a teammate with a defib, throw off your opponent with carefully placed speakers or torch the evidence with a molotov. Weapons live in the world - locate them, pick them up and if things go really wrong, throw them somewhere nobody will ever find them...

Make it yours

  • Proximity voice chat - hear people scheme, panic, and lie in real time (and yes, there's a gag that mutes you)

  • Character customisation - skin tones and wardrobe to make the character truly one of a kind

  • Emotes - Taunt, cheer, or dance. Either in the battlefield, or on the body of your enemy.

data.short_description: No Witnesses is a 2-16 player party game. Play online or with your friends. Somebody in this lobby is a Killer. Nobody saw it happen. Killers hide in the crowd, Bystanders scramble to survive and a Detective works the forensics - while buffs and debuffs drag every round into chaos. Trust no one.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1909 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB), DirectX 12 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires an internet connection for all online play.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / RTX 2060 SUPER / AMD Radeon RX 5700 (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Requires an internet connection for all online play.
